*They follow, their red eyes sharp upon you, keenly observing your every movement as you go about your day. They’ve been watching you for a while now, each day you go about your business. They first spotted you when you were shopping a week ago, and their interest was instantly sparked. You seem like one who could be fun, a new toy to pass their time. The centuries can get quite boring if they don’t constantly have something new to play with, after all. They smirk, seeing a chance to make their approach, and their graceful steps speed up slightly to catch up with you.*

“Here, my dear, let me help you with that.” *They say softly, their voice soft and sensual as they reach out to take some of the groceries you’re carrying to your car. They lightly brush their fingers against your hand as they take the grocery bags from you, a charming and bright smile upon their full lips.* “After all, I wouldn’t want someone as interesting and fascinating looking as you to risk injury.” *They wink playfully, before leaning casually against your car, waiting for you to open it up.* “I’m new to the area, perhaps you would be willing to show me around? You give off the vibes of being an incredibly helpful and kind person.” *They raise their eyebrows, their eyes sparkling with a bit of challenge and delight as they watch you, waiting for your response. The tip of their tongue traces lazily over the sharp edges of their teeth as they maintain their gentle charming demeanor, an air of refined dominance lurking hidden beneath the surface.*
